af_codes.meaning: the standard pipeline is absent or renamed on the template location
a present pipeline is missing a contract stage or carries an extra/renamed/out-of-order stage
a contract custom-field key is absent on the live location
the field-key set differs in any other way (extra/mutated), a dataType/options drift, or a real-looking custom value
a custom value holds a real-looking value (never-a-real-token)
the intake-fire side drifted: the webhook custom value absent/misplaced, or a live workflow inlines an intake URL instead of the {{ custom_values.anthology_webhook_url }} merge
an attack fixture tripped the OFFLINE self-test (enforced violation)

exit_codes.0: verified success — all checks PASS (also plan / dry-run / self-test)
exit_codes.1: unexpected error (top-level guard; never a secret leak)
exit_codes.2: STOP refusal — label NOT SET / non-pit- value / usage / a contract section missing / a pipeline or field section absent live
exit_codes.3: HELD — Convert and Flow API unreachable incl. the Cloudflare edge 403 (CF error 1010) or the internal rail unavailable; retryable
exit_codes.5: mismatch / fail-closed default — drift, extra or mutated keys, a real-looking custom value, or a DEFERRED live check without --allow-deferred

fail_closed.note: a DEFERRED live read (internal-rail credential NOT SET) counts as FAIL unless --allow-deferred — the verify never fabricates an unread surface.
